Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-374 Global - Platform connection warnings
Labels: teamextplatform

- 'TC-2334 Warning log after removing a project'

   Expected: All Atlassian Cloud projects are displayed
6. Find projectName and remove it
   Data: projectName: TC-2334 Warning log after removing a project
   Expected: project 'TC-2334 Warning log after removing a project' has been removed
7. Go to Atlassian Cloud filters using Filters > View all filters button
   Expected: All Atlassian Cloud filters are displayed

   Data: filterName: TC-2334 Filter to remove

9. Go back to BP, Gantt modue of boxName do a resync and after that refresh the page

BoxName scope is corrupted Error in scope for Jira: FolLowing elements: ID (jira_filter),ID (jira_project) are unavailable for plugin or inaccessible by Scope Owner
10. Go to Root overview module
   Expected: There shouldn't display any warning log
11. End session in the browser
   Expected: 
12. Open Jira -> go to BigPicture and Open boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-2334 Global - Platform connection warnings - Warning log after removing a project and filter from Atlassian Cloud Primary
   Expected: Warning log window with message appear :
BoxName scope is corrupted Error in scope for Jira: FolLowing elements: ID (jira_filter),ID (jira_project) are unavailable for plugin or inaccessible by Scope Owner
13. Click on "Mute notifications"
   Expected: There shouldn't display any warning log
14. Repeat steps 11 and 12
   Expected: Warning log window with message appear :
BoxName scope is corrupted Error in scope for Jira: FolLowing elements: ID (jira_filter),ID (jira_project) are unavailable for plugin or inaccessible by Scope Owner
